g.text: DEPROPANIZER COLUMN VER 1 - OPERATOR TRAINING SIMULATOR
DEPROPANIZER C-201 · FEED DRUM, COLUMN, CONDENSER AND REBOILER
1. Liquid flows m3/h; vapour kmol/h; vent Nm3/h; steam t/h; °C; kPa g. Design point of the simulator model.
2. Pseudo-binary feed: C3 and lighter / C4 and heavier. Trays numbered from the bottom; feed on tray 18.
3. XV-201/202/209: SIS shut-off valves. PSV-201 set 1.80 MPa g to flare. Steam condensate returns not shown.
